About Polygon Labs

Polygon Labs is a global blockchain payments company building and operating infrastructure to move money instantly, reliably, and at internet scale, with the mission to move all money onchain. It is building the Polygon Open Money Stack, an open and integrated stack of services and technologies to instantly and reliably move money anywhere, and put it to work. Its infrastructure has facilitated trillions of dollars in onchain value transfer and supported millions of transactions daily for some of the globe's largest banks, fintechs, enterprises, and consumer applications.

AI Platform Engineer

About the Role

We are hiring an AI Platform Engineer to help build the platform that powers every agent at Polygon Labs. Polygon is a cryptocurrency company focused on on-chain payments infrastructure. As we shift to having agents manage the majority of work across engineering, business development, compliance, support, and finance, people will supervise and guide those agents while making key decisions.

 

You will join a small, flat Platform Team reporting to the AI Platform Lead. This team owns the entire AI platform, including the agent runtime, MCP servers, guardrails, evaluations, observability, and spend tracking. The team proactively identifies opportunities where AI can accelerate, improve, or automate work company-wide—including tasks that haven’t yet been automated.

 

Our internal customers are Operators: domain experts in every function who manage fleets of agents and define standards of quality. This is a hands-on IC role, where you will write code, ship to production, and take ownership of your deliverables.

 

Your Responsibilities

  • Move agentic workflows into production, taking prototypes to robust systems for real users and owners, with SLAs (e.g. spec-to-PR agents, AI code review, incident triage, KYB review).

  • Build and manage MCP servers, including system design, hosting, security, authentication (e.g. per-user OAuth), and keeping a clean connector inventory for Slack, GitHub, Jira, HubSpot, and internal services.

  • Develop autonomous agents that act and plan across tools through trust stages: shadow, suggest, execute, and autonomous.

  • Embed guardrails into the platform, providing each agent its own identity, scoped credentials, audit logs, CI checks, approval gates, allowlists, and least-privilege access.

  • Build evaluation frameworks (test sets, regression suites, live scoring in production) so every agent releases with quality metrics tied to business outcomes.

  • Instrument agents for observability: tracing, logging, latency, cost, drift detection, and daily dashboards for Operators.

  • Track AI spend across providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter), setting budgets, alerts, and spend attribution to teams, agents, and workflows.

  • Support Operators by developing features from their requests, writing documentation, running enablement sessions, and building self-service tools.

  • Create skills and plugins centralizing company knowledge (processes, standards, security, brand), versioning and reviewing these to ensure consistent, repeatable agent output.

  • Proactively find and automate manual, repetitive processes across the company, measuring outcomes and iterating rapidly.

 

What You'll Need

  • 5+ years as a software, platform, or infrastructure engineer, including experience prior to AI coding tools. Solid grasp of system design, data modeling, testing, debugging, and code review.

  • 6-12 months shipping LLM-based systems to production, with agentic workflows in use by real end users.

  • Daily, hands-on experience with AI coding agents like Claude Code and Codex to write, test, and review production code.

  • Experience building autonomous or multi-step agents with tool use (Claude Agent SDK, Anthropic/OpenAI APIs, or similar).

  • MCP server experience (OAuth flows, scoped tokens, user-level access control).

  • Identity and access experience: Okta (or similar IdP), SSO (SAML/OIDC), SCIM provisioning, group-based and device policies.

  • Creating automated system identities (GitHub Apps, service accounts, API keys, secret managers like 1Password).

  • Designing guardrails: least-privilege, audit logs, CI checks, approval gates, allowlists, and policy-as-code.

  • Creating evals for LLM systems: test sets, rubrics, CI regression, release gates, and live production scoring.

  • Instrumenting production system observability: tracing, metrics, alerting, dashboards (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Datadog, Langfuse, LangSmith, Braintrust).

  • Tracking AI spend across vendors: per-key limits, cost centers, budgets, actionable alerts.

  • Strong in at least one of TypeScript, Python, Go; working knowledge of CI/CD (GitHub Actions/etc), cloud infrastructure.

  • Track record of independently identifying and automating manual processes (two or three concrete examples).

  • Clear, concise written communication (specs, runbooks, RFCs).

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Cryptocurrency, blockchain, payments, or fintech experience (regulated industry/audit a plus).

  • Experience writing agent skills, plugins, or shared prompt libraries for organizational reuse.

  • Familiarity with model gateways (OpenRouter, LiteLLM, Portkey): key management, routing, fallback.

  • Experience extending open-source coding agents (OpenCode, Pi).

  • Awareness of emerging agent identity standards (MCP enterprise-managed auth, Okta Cross App Access).

  • Context/retrieval engineering: vector stores, agent memory, permissioned retrievals.

  • ML engineering: model evaluation, fine-tuning, model routing.

  • Experience with agent runtimes/sandboxes (Modal, n8n, containerized environments).

  • Public technical work: open-source tools, servers, blog posts, talks about agent production experience.

 

How You’ll Work

  • Treat Operators as the customer—supporting engineers and non-engineers in every business function.

  • Listen to needs, refine vague asks into actionable requirements, and communicate technical concepts plainly to executives or subject matter experts.

  • Assertively but diplomatically push back on unsafe or low-value requests, suggesting alternatives.

  • Operate autonomously: write specs, break down projects, ship and iterate independently, and communicate progress asynchronously across time zones.

  • Use judgment to distinguish critical automations from temporary demos, and validate changes with affected users.

  • Own outcomes post-merge: pilot, monitor, fix, and iterate as needed.

  • Work transparently in public channels, tickets, written docs, and runbooks.

  • Create reusable assets (skills, plugins, templates, tools) from frequent learnings or solutions, making them broadly accessible across the company.

 

Success in 90 Days

  • 30 days: Ship production changes to a live system (e.g. AI SDLC pipeline, code review, or spend analytics). Gain familiarity with agent runtime, MCP servers, spend tracking.

  • 60 days: Take end-to-end ownership of a platform area, publishing a spec and meeting with relevant Operators.

  • 90 days: Ship an agent with live-scored eval suite and Operator dashboard; complete an Operator request independently; propose and launch at least one unsolicited automation.

Are you passionate about finding the best engineering and technical talent in the industry? Ripple is looking for a Manager of Technical Recruiting to join our dynamic team. As our Manager of Technical Recruiting, you will develop and implement innovative strategies to attract hard-to-find technical talent, including software engineers, blockchain and protocol engineers, security, SRE/infrastructure, data, and engineering leadership. You will partner with engineering, tech, and business leaders to understand their hiring needs, and provide guidance on market trends, candidate availability, and compensation benchmarks for competitive technical talent markets. You will lead, coach, and train a team of contract technical recruiters, setting clear expectations and holding the team accountable for results, and work collaboratively with HR partners to ensure a seamless and positive candidate experience.

The successful candidate will be an exceptional communicator, highly organized, and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment with competing priorities. If you are a strategic problem solver who balances attention to detail with the big picture, is comfortable rolling up your sleeves to recruit alongside your team, and is passionate about attracting and retaining the best technical talent, we want to hear from you!

What you’ll do:

  • Build a contract recruiting team that performs like a top in-house team. You’ll set a high bar for your contract recruiters, assign searches by domain and capacity, coach them on sourcing and closing, and run pipeline reviews that lead to action. You’ll make direct calls on who stays, who grows and who rolls off.
  • Hire the technical talent and engineers who will shape Ripple’s next chapter. You’ll personally own Ripple’s most critical technical searches, including Staff+ and Principal engineers, engineering leaders, and domain specialists in protocol, distributed systems, security, and infrastructure. These are high-impact hires that define what our teams can build, and you’ll drive them from first outreach to signed offer.
  • Be the partner engineering and technical leaders turn to when a search is stuck. You use funnel data, market signals, and candidate feedback to diagnose why a role is off track, quickly pivoting the strategy to get hiring back on schedule before escalation is needed.
  • Find talent no one else is reaching. You’ll build pipelines in open source communities, GitHub, protocol and developer forums, conferences, academic labs and engineering referral networks. You’ll treat sourcing as an always-on advantage rather than something that starts when a req opens.
  • Raise the bar on how Ripple assesses technical talent. You’ll partner with technical and engineering leaders to design structured interview loops, calibrate on what great looks like for each role, and maintain rigorous evaluation standards to ensure hiring decisions are grounded in evidence rather than gut feel.
  • Use AI where it measurably helps. You’ll find where AI can improve sourcing, market research, outreach and screening prep. You’ll run focused pilots against a clear baseline, scale what works and drop what doesn’t, and keep humans in charge of judgment calls about candidates and how we treat them.
  • Turn what works into repeatable playbooks. Your best sourcing strategies, closing approaches and search playbooks become standard practice for the wider technical recruiting team.
  • Shape where we invest. You’ll feed hiring capacity planning, manage agency and contractor spend for cost and results, and bring leadership clear, data-backed recommendations on tradeoffs, not just status updates.
  • Keep the basics clean: consistent process, accurate data in the ATS, and full EEO/AA compliance across the team.

  • A track record of closing the searches that matter most. You’ve hired Staff+ and Principal engineers, technical leaders and narrow specialists (distributed systems, security, infrastructure, protocol or blockchain). You can walk us through the hardest one: how you found the person, why they said yes, and what nearly derailed it.
  • Proven resilience and grit when facing hard-to-fill searches. When roles stall, candidate pipelines fall short, or offers are declined, you proactively pivot your strategy to uncover new solutions rather than waiting for the market to shift.
  • Credibility with engineers. You understand the technical work well enough to tell strong candidates from people who just list the right buzzwords. You can hold a real conversation about someone’s systems and tradeoffs, and senior engineers take your calls because you’re worth talking to.
  • You lead other recruiters while carrying a full req load, and both sides deliver. You’ve set expectations for contract or external recruiters, run pipeline reviews, given direct feedback, and measurably improved their output, without your own searches suffering
  • You run off recruiting data. You’ve used funnel data (pass-through rates, source quality, time in stage, decline reasons) to find out why a search was stuck, changed your approach, and shown that the change worked. You bring hiring managers data and recommendations, not just status updates.
  • You find talent where others don’t look. Open source contributors, conference speakers, niche forums, academic labs, and overlooked referral networks. You’ve built pipelines from scratch with little budget or tooling. You go deep on the domain, learning the market, the technology, and how competitors are hiring without being asked, so you can explain why an engineer would leave big tech for Ripple and what would make them say no.

This role covers HR management, payroll, compensation, job leveling, and employee development, supported by strong operational skills and practical use of AI tools.

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.


Kraken and Payward VIP team supports the firm’s highest-value private clients: high-net-worth individuals who expect a premium, secure, and deeply tailored experience. We ensure Kraken remains the exchange of choice for VIPs through white-glove relationship management, personalized trading enablement, and high-impact benefits.

We are looking for a Head of VIP, Asia to lead and grow Payward VIP presence across the region. This is a player-coach role: you will build and lead a small, high-performing team while personally owning strategic client relationships, originating new business, and shaping the regional growth playbook.

You will set the standard for how Kraken serves, retains, and grows its most valuable private clients in Asia. You will be equally comfortable in a senior client meeting, building an introducer network, coaching a relationship manager, hosting a VIP event, and partnering internally to remove the product or operational barriers that cost us high-value business.

Payward VIP program is unique, and we intend to keep it that way. We don’t copy what other exchanges and desks do. You’ll take what makes our program different and adapt it to how Asia’s VIP clients actually trade, network, and build trust. That means testing new ideas, learning fast, dropping what doesn’t work, and scaling what does. If you’re bold, comfortable with ambiguity, and humble enough to fail fast and move on, this is your seat.

 
 

The opportunity

  • Lead, coach, and develop VIP relationship managers in Asia; establish clear standards for client coverage, pipeline management, service quality, and commercial performance.

  • Build the operating model for VIP growth across Asia, including territory coverage, account segmentation, referral strategy, events, and performance reporting.

  • Own regional AOP growth, net deposits, client assets, trading volume, retention, and revenue performance.

  • Build a repeatable pipeline of qualified high-value clients through direct outreach, referrals, introducers, family offices, proprietary trading firms, OTC desks, miners, project treasuries, and high-volume traders.

  • Represent the voice of Asia’s VIP client base internally: identify competitive threats, regional market dynamics, product gaps, and opportunities that influence where private-client capital trades.

Personally own strategic client relationships

  • Own and grow Kraken's most strategically important private client relationships across Asia, bringing our full VIP offering - ranging from trading and asset management to other services - to market locally, within Kraken's compliance and risk framework.

  • Serve as the senior relationship owner for Kraken’s largest and most strategically important private clients across Asia.

  • Bring Kraken’s VIP and private-client offering to market locally, including spot, margin, futures, OTC execution, earn and yield opportunities, lending, and tailored benefits.

  • Build trusted, durable relationships while ensuring every client interaction and commercial initiative operates within Kraken’s licensing, compliance, and risk framework.

Build regional presence and partnerships

  • Develop Kraken’s presence in Asia’s VIP trading and investor communities, including private trading groups, investor clubs, KOL and trader networks, and closed-door investor circles.

  • Design and lead high-quality regional programming, including VIP dinners, trader meetups, conference-adjacent events, and partner activations, in collaboration with Marketing and Regional teams.

  • Build and manage introducer and referral partnerships that create a durable source of qualified VIP opportunities.

  • Partner with Product, Marketing, Compliance, Banking, Client Service, and Operations to launch regional growth initiatives and improve the client experience.

 
 

What you bring

  • 7+ years of experience in VIP relationship management, private banking, brokerage, private-client sales, account management, or business development, including meaningful experience in crypto or digital assets.

  • Demonstrated people leadership experience, with the judgment and practical coaching ability to lead a small team while remaining hands-on with strategic clients and revenue opportunities.

  • A strong personal network among Asia’s crypto HNWIs, traders, family offices, OTC desks, funds, or trading communities. Experience across Greater China, Hong Kong, Taiwan, or Singapore is especially valuable.

  • A proven record of personally originating and converting new business, not solely servicing an existing client book.

  • Deep knowledge of crypto market structure and trading solutions, including spot, margin, futures, OTC, lending, tokenized equities, and yield/earn products.

  • Strong commercial judgment and comfort managing KPIs including assets on platform, net deposits, revenue, trading volume, retention, pipeline conversion, and client portfolio growth.

  • Native or near-native Mandarin and fluent English.

  • Comfort operating across multiple regulated Asian jurisdictions, with sound judgment on when to engage Compliance and Risk partners early.

  • Willingness to travel up to 30% across the region for strategic client meetings, events, and conferences.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

About Riot Platforms

Riot’s (NASDAQ: RIOT) vision is to be the world’s most trusted platform for powering and building digital infrastructure. Riot’s mission is to empower the future of digital infrastructure by positively impacting the sectors, networks, and communities that we touch. We believe that the combination of an innovative spirit and strong community partnership allows us to achieve best-in-class execution and create successful outcomes.

Who we are

At Riot, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure. Our team members have unparalleled opportunities to work on groundbreaking initiatives. Through technical excellence and strategic execution, Riot has positioned itself as a leader in the industry driving advancements that continue to set new benchmarks in digital infrastructure. 

We are trailblazers. Problem solvers. People who thrive in fast paced environments, communicate clearly, and bring relentless focus to efficiency and execution.

About the role

Riot Platforms is seeking a Senior Engineer, Identity & Access Management (IAM) to design, implement, and operate modern identity security capabilities across our enterprise, cloud, SaaS, and data center environments. This role will be hands-on and highly technical, with responsibility for building secure, scalable, and automated identity solutions that support Riot’s continued growth into AI/HPC and data center operations.

The Senior IAM Engineer will work closely with Cybersecurity, IT, Cloud, Infrastructure, Data Center Operations, People Operations, and GRC.

This position will be based in our Austin office. Relocation assistance is available for non-local candidates. 

What you'll do

  • Design, implement, and support IAM solutions across Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, SaaS, cloud, and data center environments.
  • Manage and optimize SSO, Conditional Access, MFA, passwordless authentication, PIM, RBAC, and identity lifecycle controls.
  • Implement and maintain Privileged Access Management (PAM) capabilities, including privileged account onboarding, credential rotation, session controls, and removal of standing access.
  • Support Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) processes including joiner/mover/leaver workflows, access reviews, entitlement management, and role-based access.
  • Automate user and access provisioning using technologies such as SCIM, APIs, scripting, PowerShell, and workflow automation.
  • Engineer secure access for vendors, contractors, partners, and other third-party users.
  • Develop and maintain controls for service accounts, application identities, API access, secrets, certificates, and other non-human identities.
  • Integrate enterprise applications with SSO using SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and related standards.
  • Troubleshoot authentication, authorization, provisioning, and federation issues.
  • Partner with Cybersecurity Operations to investigate identity-related threats, anomalous authentication, credential compromise, and privilege escalation.
  • Maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, standards, and operating procedures.
  • Support IAM-related audit and compliance activities, including SOX, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 evidence and control testing.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual processes, strengthen security, and improve the user experience.

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years of IAM, cybersecurity engineering, identity engineering, or related technical experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft identity technologies, especially Entra ID and Active Directory.
  • Demonstrated experience integrating enterprise applications with SSO and automated provisioning.
  • Experience implementing or supporting PAM, PIM, Conditional Access, MFA, and access governance.
  • Strong understanding of least privilege, Zero Trust, RBAC, authentication, authorization, and identity lifecycle management.
  • Experience scripting and automating IAM processes using PowerShell, APIs, or similar tools.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across identity, networking, federation, and application integrations.
  • Ability to work effectively across Cybersecurity, IT, Infrastructure, and business teams.
  • Preferred experience with CyberArk or comparable privilege management technologies.
  • Preferred experience with SailPoint or comparable entitlements management technologies.
  • Preferred experience supporting cloud, data center, critical infrastructure, or AI/HPC environments.
  • Preferred experience with SOX, SOC 2, ISO, NIST CSF, and Zero Trust architectures.
  • Certification in Microsoft, CyberArk, SailPoint, CISSP, CCSP, or equivalent.

Compensation and Benefits 

  • Competitive Salary: Base salary (commensurate with experience) + bonus + sign-on equity grant. 
  • Long-Term Growth: Eligible to participate in Riot’s equity incentive programs and share in the success you help build. 
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan: Incudes a generous company match. 
  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Multiple medical plan options, including 100% company-paid plans. 
  • Wellness & Lifestyle Perks: Enjoy free gym memberships, pet insurance, childcare discounts, and more to support your life both in and out of work. 

Riot is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

About Mantle

We’re building an AI agent to help families support their aging parents (origin story here).

 

Over 40M “sandwich generation” Americans currently manage their parent’s affairs. Keeping mom/dad safe and supported is like a second job: it’s time-consuming, stressful and on top of their already busy lives. We believe that managing our parents’ affairs should feel under control, easier and lower stress.

 

Co-founded by serial entrepreneur partners including Ted Zagat, who sold his previous businesses to Slack (announcement here) and Google (Zagat restaurant guides).

The Role

We are looking for a Social & Content Marketing Manager to build Mantle's voice in the world. The sandwich generation is juggling a lot, and the content they see about caring for aging parents is too often clinical, overwhelming or dull. You'll create content that feels like a helpful friend: honest, useful and human. You will work side-by-side with our founders and marketing team to grow an audience that trusts Mantle.

This is a role for a builder and a maker. In the early days, you'll be the one writing the posts, filming the videos, working with creators and responding to comments yourself. It's not just about strategy; it's about consistently shipping great content, learning what resonates, and doing more of it.

What You'll Build

  • Social presence: Grow Mantle's organic audience across Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube and wherever our families spend time.

  • Content engine: Create and publish a steady stream of short-form video, posts, articles and newsletters.

  • Creator partnerships: Find and partner with creators and voices our audience already trusts.

  • Brand voice: Help define how Mantle sounds and shows up to the world.

  • Community: Engage directly with the people who follow and share our content.

  • Content analytics: Track what's resonating and turn those learnings into better content.

What We're Looking For

Required Experience

  • 3+ years of social media and content marketing experience, ideally at a consumer startup or high-growth company

  • Track record of growing an organic audience and engagement on at least two major platforms

  • Strong writing skills and comfort creating short-form video yourself

  • Experience working with creators or influencers

  • AI adept: savvy with AI tools (LLMs, agents) to increase your own personal leverage

Ideal Background

  • Early-stage startup experience where you were the first social or content hire

  • Experience marketing to busy adults, especially parents or caregivers

  • Experience making complex or sensitive topics feel simple and approachable

  • A portfolio of content you're proud of

  • Nice to have, but not required: experience with FinTech

Who Thrives Here

  • Builders: You love creating things from scratch and taking full ownership

  • Makers: You'd rather ship ten posts and learn than plan one perfect one

  • Empathetic: You understand what our audience is going through and write for them

  • Scrappy: You operate well without a lot of structure or resources and find ways to "get it done"

  • AI-forward: You embrace modern AI

  • Autonomous: You thrive with minimal direction

  • Mission-driven: You care about what we're building

What You'll Get

  • Meaningful work: Build a brand that will make a real difference in the lives of millions of families, with fast pace and huge financial potential

  • Small team impact: Work directly with founders and see immediate impact from your work

  • Partnership with founders: Work closely with Mantle's co-founders and other company leaders

  • Learning & growth: Opportunity to build a category-defining company from the ground up

  • Real ownership: Your decisions will shape our brand, business and culture

  • Remote Fridays: Work from home every Friday. Monday through Thursday, we build together in person in San Francisco
